newsitem.title: CHINA: China International Travel 96 net up 10.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: China International Travel 96 net up 10.25 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net asset per share 2.84 yuan vs 2.67 yuan
Earnings per share 0.37 yuan vs 0.34 yuan
Company name: The Shanghai China International Travel Service Co Ltd
Note: the results were published in a company statement. The net profit numbers are based on international accounting standards, other figures are based on domestic accounting standards.
Based on domestic accounting standards, the 1996 net profit was 44.375 million yuan against 41.067 million yuan in 1995.
The company's board of directors has proposed a cash dividend of 0.20 yuan per share based on the 1996 net, pending approval of shareholders, the statement said.
